en.muhajir-b-ali: 2. It has been narrated that Al-Sadiq (a.s) said
“For a muslim, whatever Allah ﷻ has decreed is good, and if he comes to possess all that is in the East and West,it will be good for him.”
Then, he recited this verse “So, Allah protected him from the evil of their plot” [40:45].
Then he (al-Sadiq) said “By Allah, they overpowered him (i.e. the one intended in the previous Holy Verse) and killed him but what Allah protected him from was being overcome in his faith.”
